sageh.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Sage GL History' tab — read fresh every run per SKILL.md §2c; baked payload is only the fallback (never splice null). R35: optional disc ($, GL-negative) + gross series from the Discount % column. R37: optional nrMgn / cbMgn / wtyMgn series — the Non-Rev / Callback / Warranty Margin columns, dollars exactly as the Summary card's Margin row (negative = loss; blank → 0; all three to BOTH trades or to neither). The R36 nrEro/cbEro/wtyEro keys are RETIRED — no Excel column ever carried them. The Trends margin section hides when a payload lacks the keys

june_parity.caveat: R38: membership revenue moves revenue/GM whenever goals.json carries mem keys — June parity holds ONLY when the goals payload has no mem block (mem absent → byte-identical to R37, verified). R40 adds only the review layer and one exposed accessor - it cannot move revenue, GM or job counts (verified identical to R39 on July exports).

release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.
notes: R40 (2026-07-31): review-accountability layer. PPUI now exposes result() and reviewState() so the nightly flag snapshot reads the engine's OWN job list - no flag logic re-implemented outside the template. New AGES marker carries the flag-age ledger (markers 7 -> 8). Jobs tab gains a sortable, colour-banded Age column; GM notes render as a banner on the reviewer's row. New GM-only Review Desk tab (latched by ?gm=1): per-trade queue cards (owner, open count, revenue in queue, oldest flag, approved last 7d, watchlist, approved-then-went-bad), 0-2/3-7/8-14/15+ age bands, reviewer-activity table, and the open-flag table oldest-first with + Note. State shape gains notes{} plus note/notedone/noteclear ops. BUGFIX: the !STX.wired() guard on checkReflags() is REMOVED - before R40, turning sync on silently disabled approved-then-went-bad detection; checkReflags is idempotent so any viewer may surface a reflag. Queues split by TRADE not service manager (HVAC->Eric/Thomas, Plumbing->Reuben/Anna): dim_employee.current_service_manager_name covers only 54 of 105 active LV techs, every installer blank, attributing just 10.8% of revenue - trade is already on every job record. CFG is spliced at BUILD time and never baked into pp_template.html, so the plaintext master and SharePoint backups stay secret-free. Verified 2026-07-31 vs R39 on the same July exports (07/01-07/30): 3,884 jobs, $5,647,396, GM 55.9%, gates 6/6, zero engine errors - identical. Flag parity vs the live published dashboard: 272 = 272 on the same window, using production goals lifted from the live index.html (30 HVAC bands, 35 Plumbing). Review Desk render-verified in jsdom: 2 queue cards, 272 open rows, 272 age pills, 0 errors. P&L math, parsers, accrual, Handoff and Trends untouched.

mem.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Margin Variables' tab — 'Other Revenue' block (Membership row: Revenue $ + Purchases $, branch monthly totals)
mem.split: 94% HVAC / 6% Plumbing, applied at ingest into PP_GOALS[trade].mem={rev,cost}
mem.behavior: MTD = monthly x calendar elapsedFrac; pace carries the full monthly figure exactly; cost lands in Purchases; all margins/% re-base to TOTAL revenue; mem absent/invalid → renders exactly R37

r39.caps: service-side 480 min/job, install 720 min/job; CB/WT worked entirely by an install crew inherit the install cap
r39.time_source: Job Costing 'Start of Working Time' / 'End of Working Time' x crew count from 'Assigned Technicians'; bucket median backfills the ~2% of jobs with no usable stamps
r39.rate: scope GP (and CP) split between service and install by share of job-attributed margin, divided by that side's man-minutes; lost minutes priced by the side of the tech who logged them
r39.caveat: opportunity cost at current productivity - not recoverable cash

r40.attribution: by trade, never by service manager - SMs help sell the job and do not review
r40.token_scope: fine-grained Contents read+write on the private repo ONLY - verified: write to the public pages repo returns 403
r40.aging_caveats: capped=true ages are floors (rendered >=Nd); cost-maturity inflates 0-2d flags (NO-PAY swung 26->88->48 on consecutive days); approval does NOT clear a flag in the data, so age alone cannot separate 'never looked at' from 'reviewed and accepted'
r40.gm_gate: ?gm=1 latches pp_gm in that browser - a visibility choice, NOT a security boundary
